# `csharp_place_simple_blocks_on_single_line`

The same, for a lambda or anonymous method's block body.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_place_simple_blocks_on_single_line = true`

```ini
csharp_place_simple_blocks_on_single_line = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Action<int> log = x =>
        {
            Console.WriteLine(x);
        };
        log(1);
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Action<int> log = x => { Console.WriteLine(x); };
        log(1);
    }
}
```
:::

::::
